name: 🍠 Sheet Pan Chicken, Sweet Potato & Broccoli
tagline: One pan, high heat, crispy edges: the weeknight dinner that cleans up in five minutes.

items.name: Honey or hot honey, to drizzle

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F with two sheet pans inside (hot pans = crispy bottoms).
Toss the sweet potatoes with 2 Tbsp oil, salt and paprika. Roast on one pan for 10 minutes first.
Meanwhile toss the chicken with 1 Tbsp oil, garlic, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Toss the broccoli with the last oil and a pinch of salt.
Stir the potatoes and push them to one side. Add the chicken to that pan and the broccoli to the second pan. Roast 15–18 minutes until the chicken is 165°F and the broccoli edges are dark.
Squeeze the lemon over everything, shower with parmesan, and drizzle a little honey on the sweet potatoes.
Pack a lunch box before serving.

kid_jobs.job: Toss the broccoli in oil and salt (clean hands work best)
Zest and squeeze the lemon at the end

chef_tip: Don't crowd the pans. Give everything space and preheat the pans: that's the difference between steamed and roasted.
make_ahead: Cut the sweet potatoes and broccoli the night before; keep in zip bags in the fridge.
leftovers: Great cold or reheated for lunch; or wrap it in a tortilla with ranch.
swaps: Broccoli florets bag (i055) to skip chopping
serve_with: Nothing else needed; add naan if you want bread
heads_up: Oven to 425°F with the sheet pans inside.

game_plan.what: Oven to 425°F with both sheet pans inside.
Sweet potatoes on the hot pan for 10 min. Kids season the chicken.
Kids toss the broccoli with oil and salt.
Chicken in with the potatoes, broccoli on pan two: 15–18 min.
Kids add lemon, parmesan and a drizzle of honey.
Straight from the pans to the table.
